entries.what: Jun opens the espresso bar at Heron & Grind, then pours tulip-rosetta stacks for Wes's usual 7 a.m. cortado.
entries.outcome: Quiet Monday off the schedule, no rush.

entries.what: Evening at his room in the fourplex off Vinca Avenue, he checks Linh's sheet and plans the week's wrapper order.
entries.outcome: Wrapper list written for Ruiz Family Market.

entries.what: Tuesday opener at Heron & Grind; he coaches Linh through a swan pour between rushes.
entries.outcome: Linh gets her swan on the third try.

entries.what: After work he buys wrappers and shrimp at Ruiz Family Market, then calls Paolo about Saturday prep.
entries.outcome: Paolo promises to show up early.

entries.what: The county health permit approval email arrives; Jun reads it twice at the cafe counter and then shows Linh.
entries.outcome: Permit approved for commissary-prepared food; he plans to post it on the stall banner.

entries.what: He texts Tess and Paolo the news, then celebrates with al pastor at Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Tess says to print the permit big.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind until 9 p.m., scrubbing the machine and restocking oat milk.
entries.outcome: Closed on time with nothing left undone.

entries.what: Late night he prints the permit and tapes a checklist for the fryer.
entries.outcome: Permit copy ready for the banner.

entries.what: Halloween on Calle Ortega: the cafe hands out candy and Jun serves costumed kids hot chocolate.
Friday 5-9 p.m. block at the Ruel Road commissary, rolling lumpia with Paolo and scrubbing the fryer area before time is up.
entries.outcome: Avoided Joan's $40 fee and finished the batch.

entries.what: Saturday counter at Heron & Grind: sells lumpia at the Saturday table, Wes buys his two in quarters.
That night, before Rick confirms his slot, Jun impulsively orders a 10x10 white canopy and weights for $189.
entries.outcome: Canopy ordered; he hopes the slot comes through.

entries.what: Rick confirms Jun's Sunday stall in row C near the bandstand at Delgado Park; he skips pickup basketball to set up.
He sells through the day with the permit on the banner; the week's batch now runs about 400 lumpia.
Evening at home he tallies sales in Linh's sheet and falls asleep early.
